checks.name: Elbow
checks.detailed_advice: Your front arm extension is excellent! This positioning allows maximum power transfer through the shot. Keep practicing this form.

checks.name: Head
checks.detailed_advice: Your head is moving too much (dipping or falling away). This causes you to lose sight of the ball. Practice the 'nose over toes' drill - your nose should stay over your front toe throughout the shot. Try batting with a cap and place a tennis ball on top to train stability.

checks.name: BackFoot
checks.detailed_advice: Excellent back foot stability! Your base is solid, allowing proper weight transfer. This foundation is key to generating power.

checks.name: Hips
checks.detailed_advice: You need much more hip rotation. You're mostly using your arms, which limits power significantly. Think 'hips lead, hands follow'. Practice shadow shots focusing ONLY on hip rotation first, then add the arms. Watch videos of professional batters in slow motion to see how early and aggressive their hip turn is.

checks.name: Finish
checks.detailed_advice: Beautiful high finish! Your hands completed the full arc, showing complete commitment to the shot. This maximizes power and control.

form_analysis.summary: Good form with minor technical adjustments needed.
form_analysis.enhanced_summary: ⚠️ Decent attempt but several technical issues to address. Focus on improving: Head, Hips. Keep practicing and you'll see improvement!
